title: GET /events response (B.2 change feed)
description: ?after=<seq>&limit=<=1000&types=task.*,goal.*&excludeOrigin=gauzy:<id>. Only pinned orgs. Events of aggregates that are private at event time are never served, EXCEPT <aggregate>.visibility_changed to private, which is always served with data {id, visibility:'private'} so consumers stop syncing. Events are in ascending, gap-free seq order. `nextCursor` is the seq to pass as `after` next time (null when there is nothing after this page); `head` is the newest feed position overall (positions are global across organizations, so a quiet organization's cursor can always be advanced to `head`; `head` is never below the retention floor). A cursor older than retention answers 410 cursor_expired (full resync). task.runtime_updated is excluded unless `types` names it exactly.
